name: Warp-shuffle prefix-sum scan
description: A register-shuffle (__shfl_up_sync) inclusive prefix sum: an intra-warp shuffle scan followed, for multi-warp blocks, by a shared-memory cross-warp broadcast; launched at 32 (single-warp) and 256 (multi-warp) block sizes.
output_description: CUDA executable writes numeric output to output/cuda_output.txt.

performance.notes: Runtime logs are written by tools/benchmark_case.py.

extraction_notes: shfl_scan_test reproduced verbatim from NVIDIA/cuda-samples shfl_scan.cu, launched at two block sizes (32 and 256). Host driver, gen_in, CMakeLists, and Python oracle are new. Snapshot sk-11.
notes: Real-extraction warp-shuffle scan case from collection snapshot sk-11. n=262144, in[i]=(i%9)+1; output = 256-wide segmented inclusive scan. Exact oracle (segment sum <= 2304).
